notes.title: [New Version Test] Armor of Doom - Explosive New Update Arrives on March 29, 202
notes.content:
New Gameplay
【Tank Mayhem - Enhanced Gameplay】The brand-new CTF (Capture the Flag) mode makes its glorious debut! Experience intense 5v5 team deathmatches with unlimited respawns that completely liberate combat restrictions. More intense strategic confrontations and more exhilarating battlefield experiences await - come join this multi-dimensional tactical steel feast!

I. Testing Schedule
Daily server opening time: 20:00 (UTC-4) - 04:00 (UTC-4). The server will be under maintenance during other hours.

II. Version Content
This update brings rich content across multiple aspects:

    New Gameplay Features:
    ○ New Crew Recruitment System: Enhance your team's strength by recruiting crew members with different specialties.
    ○ Lucky Draw: Get chances to win rare items and powerful resources through exciting draws.
    ○ Points Exchange: Use accumulated in-game points to exchange for desired items.
    ○ Peak Tournament Leaderboard: Compete for glory! Top commanders will receive rare tanks, exclusive avatar frames, and other luxurious rewards that showcase your dominance in the tank world.

    Enhanced Reward System:
    ○ Timed Rewards: Log in during specific periods to claim generous rewards.
    ○ Online Time Rewards: Every minute you spend in-game will be rewarded - the longer you play, the better the rewards.
    ○ New Recharge Benefits: First-time, daily, and cumulative recharge rewards to thank you for your support.
    ○ Cumulative Recharge Rewards: Receive rare rewards based on your total recharge amount (bonus gold from double events not included).

    Special Paid Features:
    ○ Monthly Card: Enjoy daily exclusive benefits for a month - perfect for long-term players.
    ○ Limited-time Flash Sales and 90%-off Bundles: Get high-value items at ultra-low prices (limited quantities available).
    ○ New Double Boost Items: Gain high returns in short time to accelerate your growth!

    Cosmetic Expansions:
    ○ 8 exquisite skins for 6 tanks to customize your armored forces.
    ○ New expressive emoji pack to enhance social interactions.
    ○ New avatar frames as exclusive status symbols.

    Powerful New Tank: The formidable TYPE 16 tank arrives with outstanding performance and firepower to dominate the battlefield.

Notes:

    Recharge rewards will be sent automatically to your in-game mailbox. Please check promptly.

    For recharge issues, contact our support team via Discord: https://discord.gg/pnshNRtKbK

notes.title: Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,

The drumbeats of the apocalypse have already sounded, and the smoke of war weaves a passionate battle song. The long-awaited new version of Armored Doom will be released on January 22, 2025, bringing a shocking new battlefield filled with both risks and opportunities, waiting for commanders like you to conquer and begin your glorious journey!

This update is rich in content, covering several aspects. The specific adjustments are as follows:

Recharge and Payment System Opened: The official recharge and payment function is now available, providing you with convenient in-game payment channels to meet all your resource acquisition needs.

New Game Modes:

A new crew recruitment system is introduced. By recruiting crew members with different characteristics, you can enhance your team’s strength.
The lottery function is now live. In this exciting lottery, you have the chance to win rare items and powerful resources.
The points exchange system is also available. You can exchange accumulated points for your desired items, making effective use of your resources.
The Peak Match Leaderboard is now online. The battle for the glory of the strongest commander awaits. The top-ranking commanders will receive luxurious rewards such as rare tanks and exclusive avatar frames. These rewards not only symbolize power but also let you show off your dominant status in the tank world, becoming the focus of everyone’s attention.
Reward System Upgrades:

A timed reward mechanism is launched. Log in during specified times to receive generous rewards, adding more excitement to your daily game routine.
Cumulative online time rewards are now available. The more time you spend in the game, the more rewards you will earn.
New recharge functions are introduced, including first-time recharge, daily recharge, and cumulative recharge. Multiple recharge rewards await your support, bringing more surprises while you top up.
The cumulative recharge reward feature is now open. Depending on your cumulative recharge, you can claim corresponding rare rewards, showcasing your prestige and power. (Note: Double rewards from bonuses are not included in the cumulative recharge calculation.)
Special Paid Features:

A monthly card function is now available. By purchasing a monthly card, you will enjoy daily exclusive benefits for an entire month—an excellent value for long-term players.
Limited-time flash sale packs and one-dollar bundles are available at a low price for high-value items. The opportunity is limited, so act fast!
Visual Content Expansion:

We have carefully crafted 8 beautiful skins for 6 tanks, adding unique charm to your tank force and allowing you to show off your individual style.
A new set of lively and interesting emojis is now available to enrich your social interactions in the game.
A brand-new avatar frame has been introduced, serving as a symbol of your exclusive identity and making your personal profile stand out.
Powerful New Vehicle Arrives, Adding a Sharp Blade to the Battlefield: The all-new TYPE 16 tank makes its debut. With its superior performance and formidable firepower, it will become a valuable ally on the battlefield.

Warm Tips:

Recharge rewards will be automatically sent to your in-game mailbox after a successful recharge. Be sure to check your mailbox promptly to avoid missing precious resources and items.
If you encounter any issues during the recharge process, feel free to contact our customer service team through our Telegram link: https://t.me/+WpGEz8KI07o3Yjg1. We are here to assist you and ensure that your gaming experience remains uninterrupted.
We will make further improvements in future versions. You are also welcome to follow us on the following platforms to stay updated on our latest development plans and news:

Discord link: https://discord.gg/pnshNRtKbK
Telegram link: https://t.me/+WpGEz8KI07o3Yjg1
X (Twitter) ID: @ARMORED_OF_DOOM
VK ID: 872928465
Thank you for your understanding and support, Commanders. We take every suggestion from our players seriously and appreciate all the valuable feedback we receive.

notes.title: Major Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,
We plan to roll out a major version update on November 5th from 05:00 to 012:00（UTC+3）. During this time, the server may be temporarily inaccessible. Here’s what’s coming in this update:

We’re adding an exciting new Capture the Flag mode:
Experience a faster-paced, thrilling battle format;
Tanks will not respawn once destroyed, meaning if you’re knocked out, it’s game over for that round;
Leaving the game early after destruction will not incur any penalty, and rewards will be distributed at the end of the match;
Commanders gain resources by capturing the central base point.
When base capture progress reaches 100%, victory is yours.
If there are enemy tanks in the base, capture progress is paused;
The more friendly tanks in the base, the faster the capture rate (up to 3 tanks at once).
And if you’d rather skip the details and just battle it out, you can also win by eliminating all enemy tanks!

Expect even more changes in future updates! We invite all commanders to follow us on these community platforms to stay updated on our development plans and news:

notes.title: Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders,

We will begin maintenance on September 27th from 11:30 to 12:30 (UTC +3). This maintenance is expected to last for 1 hours, during which the server will be temporarily inaccessible.

After a period of testing, we have identified some issues, and we sincerely apologize for this. Based on the problems encountered, we will make the following adjustments to the game in this update:

1.Updates related to AI tanks: 
(1) Improved AI tank behavior with new features such as team battles, support, and jungle. 
(2) Updated AI tank names during matchmaking.

2.Adjustments to accelerate the pace of combat:
(1) Adjusted the attack values of defensive towers.
(2) Adjusted the aggro behavior of minions.
(3) Adjusted the positions of high ground defensive towers.

3.Resolved the issue of not being able to immediately regain health after teleporting home.
4.Adjusted some Russian translations.

In future versions, we will also implement more changes, such as optimizing the friend list and adding new English voice features.

Thank you for your understanding, Commanders. We will soon establish a Discord section and will upload more of the latest and hottest information about game development on our official website, Twitter, and YouTube. We take every Commander's feedback seriously and greatly appreciate every Commander who provides us with valuable suggestions.
